description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, applies global CSS styling, imports the main App component, and renders it within the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the initial rendering environment and wraps the App component within React's StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node, wrapping it in React.StrictMode.
